text.p: SOLIDERE shares were mixed on low turnover on Thursday on the privately-operated Beirut Secondary Market (BSM).
A shares fell to $108 from $110.125 on Wednesday and B shares rose to $113.625 from $112.0. They had sharply dropped to $106.625 and $108 respectively on Thursday's first fixing.
The shares had rallied in the previous two weeks amid expectations that SOLIDERE will launch a $150 million GDR issue in October allowing non-Arab investors access to the market.
Turnover on BSM, which trades only SOLIDERE shares, was 4,101 shares from 4,138 on Wednesday. Value was $442,834 compared with $461,169.
There was no trade on the official Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE) in any of the four listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
On Wednesday, only 5,530 Eternit shares were traded at $1.875 down from $1.9375 on September 16.
The BLOM stock index fell 2.82 percent to 928.09.
